hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1; echo "===DELETE==="; hops fg delete --help 2>&1

hops fg create customersf6b08c --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string:unique record key,name:string,balance_eur:double:balance in EUR,updated_at:bigint:epoch milliseconds event time" --description "Customers initial schema" --json 2>&1
hops fg insert customersf6b08c --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -30

hops fg create customersf6b08c --version 2 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --online --features "row_id:string:unique record key,full_name:string:replaces name,balance:double:balance in varying currency,currency:string:ISO code,updated_at:bigint:epoch milliseconds event time" --description "Customers new schema (re-export)" --json 2>&1 | tail -50
